visualCharacteristics.purpose: Image mosaic: a fixed grid mixing photo tiles, a video link tile (play icon + title) and solid-color text tiles
visualCharacteristics.layout: Three-column grid on desktop with two rows; a row with fewer cells widens its last tile to fill the row; single column on mobile

contentPattern.structure: rows of up to three cells; each cell is one tile: a picture only (photo tile), a play icon plus a YouTube/Vimeo link (video tile), or heading/paragraph text (text tile). E.g. row 1: video tile | wide photo; row 2: photo | photo | 'A Shared Commitment' text

usage: Visual brand/product showcase grid with a video entry point.
reuseGuidance: Use for a fixed tile grid of mixed media. For repeating look-alike cards use a cards block.
